description: P5f complement — an Anthropic Messages request body without output_config. CC 2.1.238 emits output_config in every observed request body; a captured complement is impossible on this client. Constructed against the documented schema (verified 2026-09-14) with the absence provable by direct body inspection. Also discharges the complement for adaptive_thinking_keys_present (no thinking block), multiple_system_blocks (single system block), non_streaming_max_tokens_over_4096 (stream=false and max_tokens=1024 < 4096), max_tokens_absent (max_tokens present), orphan_tool_result and tool_result_over_limit (no tool_result), and responses_origin_path (Messages wire).
origin_note: Synthetic (not captured). No body without `output_config` can be captured from Claude Code 2.1.238 — it emits the field in every observed request. Constructed against the documented Anthropic Messages schema (the only field whose absence is the point is the one missing).
